faqs.question: What is the return policy?
faqs.answer: We offer a 30-day hassle-free return policy. Just pack the product in original packaging and schedule a pickup.

faqs.question: Is there a warranty on headphones and earbuds?
faqs.answer: Yes! All audio products come with a 1-year manufacturer warranty. Extended 2-year warranty available at ₹299.

faqs.question: How long does delivery take?
faqs.answer: Standard delivery: 3-5 business days. Express delivery: 1-2 business days (₹99 extra).

faqs.question: Are the products authentic and original?
faqs.answer: 100% authentic products sourced directly from brand authorized distributors. We are an official Razorpay merchant partner.

faqs.question: Can I pay in EMI?
faqs.answer: Yes! EMI available on all products above ₹3,000. 0% EMI for 3 months on select cards. 6/12 month options also available.

faqs.question: Is the smart watch compatible with iPhone and Android?
faqs.answer: The Smart Watch Pro works with both iOS (13+) and Android (8+). Full feature compatibility with most major smartphones.

faqs.question: What is the discount offer?
faqs.answer: Use code RECOLLECT5 for an additional 5% off. This discount is valid for 24 hours only and applies to your cart total.

faqs.question: Is COD (Cash on Delivery) available?
faqs.answer: COD available for orders up to ₹10,000 in most pin codes. Add ₹49 as COD handling charge.
